welcomeBody: Tell me what you want to do on your phone. I will do it for you, and I will always ask before anything important.
permAccessibilityWhy: This lets me read the screen and tap for you, only for tasks you approve. I never read or type passwords, PINs or OTPs.
permAccessibilitySteps: In the next screen tap "NextStep helper", then turn it on.
permMicWhy: So you can speak instead of typing. I only listen when you tap the microphone.
permNotifWhy: I can warn you about fake bank, KYC or delivery messages. I never open links, reply or delete anything.
didNotHear: I didn't hear that. Tap Speak and try again.
actionLogEmpty: Nothing yet. Tasks you approve will show up here.
looking: Let me look at this screen…
somethingWrong: Sorry, something went wrong. I have stopped.
tooLong: This is taking too long, so I stopped. Nothing was ordered or sent.
privateStep: This step is private. Please do it yourself, then tap Continue.
blocked: I can't do that, it isn't safe.
guide_more_light: More light, please. Move near a window or turn on the light.
guide_find_label: Point the camera at the medicine name.
guide_ready: Good! The name is clear. Tap Take photo.
noContacts: Add your doctor's WhatsApp number in Settings first.
cameraPermission: NextStep needs the camera to photograph your medicine.
confirmSendPhoto: Send this medicine photo to {name} on WhatsApp?
notSent: Okay, I did not send it.
pickChatYourself: Please choose the chat and tap Send yourself.
askNameHint: Tap the button and say your name.
didIHear: Did I hear your name right?
shareWhy: Family will see what NextStep did for you. Never your passwords, OTPs or messages.
shareMessage: See what NextStep is helping me with on my phone: {url}
sharingStopped: Sharing stopped. Nobody can see your activity now.
networkError: Couldn't reach NextStep. Check the internet and try again.
aiBusy: My thinking service is busy right now. Please try again in a minute. Nothing was ordered or sent.
aiQuota: My thinking service has reached today's limit. Please try again later. Nothing was ordered or sent.
micSilent: I can't hear the microphone at all. Please check that it is switched on.
micUnavailable: The microphone is not available. Please allow NextStep to use it in Settings.
savedRoutine: I've done this before, so it will be quick.
waitingInstall: Please tap Install. I'll continue as soon as it's installed.
whatToOrder: What would you like to order?
goalOrderItem: Order {item} on Blinkit with cash on delivery
sayChangePrompt: What would you like to add or change?
changeConfirm: Got it: “{text}”. Shall I go ahead?
greetingNamed: Namaste {name}. How can I help today?
greetingPlain: Namaste. How can I help today?
pointAtList: Point the camera at your grocery list.
whereTo: Where would you like to go?
cancelRideHint: To cancel a ride later, tap the NextStep button, then the mic, and say “cancel my ride”.
phoneHelpTitle: How can I help with your phone?
whatDidIMiss: What did I miss in the last hour?
soundLowAsk: Your sound is very low. Shall I turn it up?
soundFixed: Done. The sound is back on.
needsDndAccess: Please allow NextStep to change sound settings. Tap NextStep in the list, switch it on, then come back and try again.
soundLooksFine: Your sound is on and loud enough. If you still can't hear, check the earphones or Bluetooth.
dndOnAsk: Do Not Disturb is on, so the phone stays quiet. Shall I turn it off?
silentAsk: Your phone is on silent. Shall I turn the sound back on?
notSilent: Your phone is not on silent. Calls will ring.
photoGuide: Point the camera and tap Take photo.
photoReady: Here is your photo. Tap Share on WhatsApp to send it.
